name: Olvés (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a green diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged with a crowned shield of the bars of Aragon at the upper hoist and a white eagle at the lower fly.
history: Municipal flag of Olvés; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
crowned shield of the bars of Aragon at the upper hoist
eagle displayed at the lower fly
